notes.title: UPDATE - New features
notes.notes:
FEATURE UPDATE

Happy to announce that we have released a whole bunch of new and exciting features to Animated Puzzles. These new features have been available in the public beta for a while, but are now fully released!

Some of the new features are:
- "Local" option to the workshop puzzles.- This has actually been available for a while, but we forgot to announce it.! :D 
- Bevel effect option on puzzle pieces - Might make the puzzle pieces "fancier" but it takes the details out of the pictures, so we don't like it.. But, it's been requested, so there's now an option for it.. :)
- Online CO-OP - This is so much fun, you should definitely try it! 
- Local CO-OP, just start a puzzle and add a second controller. - Family fun!
- Remote play
- Remote play together

Note: Should you encounter any issues with the new update, please let us know!

Happy playing!

notes.title: Animated Puzzles - UPDATE 14/12 -16
notes.notes:
Mixed update! 
We’ve made some mixed updates and improvements, hope you will like them! ːsteamhappyː
Here’s some of the changes:

 Translations: 
Added translated store description for: Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, Russian, Danish, Norwegian and Simplified Chinese. 
Improved in-game translations for: Italian, French, Russian, Danish and Norwegian.

New “Custom Option”: Sort pieces by type 
Places frame pieces in the top of the tray.

Improved gamepad controls 
While still somewhat locked to grid for precision, the joystick now moves the cursor/selector much more freely. Giving you a smoother and faster gamepad experience.

Updates to puzzle piece tray: 
 Puzzle piece tray can now be up to 9 pieces wide instead of 5.
 The puzzle piece tray no longer closes automatically, in the case where the tray is overlaying the puzzle board and a piece is dragged towards it. If you want the tray to close automatically while it’s covering parts of the board, just drag a piece over the tray "drag button”.
 Harder to accidentally drop the tray "drag button”, while dragging it.
 You can now scroll the tray while holding a puzzle piece. Either move the puzzle piece towards top/ bottom of the tray, or use the mouse wheel while holding a piece above the tray. This should make it easier so manually sort pieces in the tray.
 You can now sort puzzles pieces within the tray while using controller. Just select the piece you want to move, hold down the A button and move it by using the joystick.

notes.title: Animated Puzzles - UPDATE 25/9 -16
notes.notes:
Finally another update! 



Here’s some of the changes we’ve made:

 Settings: 
 
 Volume sliders for music and SFX instead of just ON and OFF
 Slider for frame size.
 
 Custom options: 
 Added the possibility to set custom options for puzzles. Options available are “Disable rotate” and “lock pieces when they are in the right place”. These options are available in the “select shape” menu when you begin a new / restart a puzzle. Since custom options might make the game easier, you will not get achievements or be added to the Leaderboards on a puzzle where custom options are enabled.

 Other: 
 Added some helping sound effects in Daily challenges.
 Fixed issue where the "One Win Wonder" achievement wasn't awarded after a win.
 Hopefully fixed the “missing piece” bug that occasionally occurred.

notes.title: Animated Puzzles - Update 17/8 -16
notes.notes:
New Update!  

 Workshop  

 We've rebuilt the puzzle creator and changed it into a visual tool. 
You will now start off with a preview of your image, including a white puzzle grid above it. To the right you will have a puzzles piece selector, where you can select how many pieces wide, you would like your puzzle to be. Currently ranging from about 3 to about 35, depending on the resolution of your image. As you pull the drag handle to select the number, the puzzle grid will update itself. It will show you how the pieces will be divided and how much of the image will be cut to fit your selection. The number of pieces that are a perfect match for your image resolution, will be marked green. 
 You are now able to go back to piece select after entering crop mode.
 Puzzle preview / icon. Since we've changed the resolution of the preview image a few times, the preview images might look a bit different compare to one another. You can update your preview images by going to our ingame workshop page, select the puzzle you'd like to update, click on the Steam icon then select edit. Then just press submit and the preview image will be updated.
 Workshop now supports up to about 800 pieces, depending on the resolution of your image.
 Removed the white cloud particle effect from workshop puzzles, so it’s less distracting on smaller puzzle pieces.

 Other
 
 Fixed the puzzle frame corners.

notes.title: Animated Puzzles - Small update
notes.notes:
Bug fix - Workshop 

We've had some workshop issues when creating own puzzles from larger / detailed images.

The icons generated from these images could sometimes exceed the icon size limit, which made the puzzle generation incomplete. We have lowered the icon resolution, in hope that this will eliminate the problem. If you've experienced problems when trying to create a workshop puzzle, please try again. 

If anyone encounters further issues with this, please let us know!

notes.title: Animated Puzzles - Update 11/8 -16
notes.notes:
New update! 

Just released an updated based on some of the feedback that we’ve gotten so far! 
Here’s some of the changes included in the update:

 Battle 
 
 Unaccepted friends now hidden from friends list.
 A separate list with friends that has played Animated Puzzles.
 Friends lists now in alphabetic order.
 Ability to remove a battle request before it has been initiated by the other player.
 
 Workshop 
 
 New system for number of pieces. The system reads the size of your picture and calculates options for how many pieces it can fit without cutting too much of the picture. Depending on the size of the picture it might not find a perfect fit and will then give you the closest options. It will also show how many percent of the picture will be cut. The system will give you options within different size categories marked S, M, L, XL, XXL. High resolution images will have more size categories, currently ranging up to about 400 pieces depending on the proportions. Next step will let you crop the image if needed, just as before.
 
 Other: 
 
 Bigger frame on our animated puzzles.
 Rotate images mid-air using mouse: Hold image with left mouse button and right click to rotate.
 Clicking "pause" with gamepad from ingame, while having the puzzle piece holder out, will no longer also pick the currently selected piece.
